jobs.title: Biz Ops Coordinator (Temporary position for Maternity Leave)
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

The Business Operations Coordinator will support the efficient functioning of the business by managing various operational tasks. This role involves coordinating with different departments (DevOps, Finance, NetOps Legal), handling multiple tasks in parallel,  working with multiple vendors and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.

Responsibilities:

- Assist with the execution of business projects and initiatives.

- Manage the delivery and installation process of new PoPs.

- Manage the Logistics of all PoP gear and network, including order submission and inventory monitoring.

- Manage and track ongoing tasks, including forecasting.

- Coordinate Operational tasks with various vendors.

- Maintain and update tasks on a weekly basis.

- Provide operational support to various departments as needed.

Req uirements:

- A strong “how can we make it happen” mindset, with a proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership.

- Ability to manage and support multiple processes in parallel in a fast-paced environment.

- Good communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work with multiple teams, departments, and external stakeholders.

- High self-learning ability and motivation to continuously learn new tools and business.

- Familiarity with operational and monitoring tools such as Jira and Grafana (hands-on experience is an advantage).

- Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently while being a strong team player.

- Basic networking knowledge - An advantage.

- Occasional availability after work hours (on urgent occasions).

- Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain or Business Economics - An advantage.

jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive  Business Operations Specialist  to support the ongoing operations of the Support organization.

The role combines department-wide operational ownership with administrative support for the department Chief, and includes responsibility for events, budget management, vendors, systems, and ongoing organizational needs.

Responsibilities

- Manage ongoing operational activities and projects across the Support organization.

- Lead the planning and execution of global Support events at scale, covering venues, travel, vendors, logistics, budgets, contracts, and on-site coordination.

- Own the department’s annual budget planning and ongoing management, including spend tracking, forecasting, reporting, budget utilization, invoices, financial visibility for leadership, and the implementation and ongoing management of the supporting budget-management solution and related financial processes.

- Manage initiatives arising from Regional Councils and other Support programs, including prioritization, stakeholder coordination, execution, and follow-through.

- Manage operational systems and tools, including implementation of new solutions and ongoing coordination with vendors around renewals, contracts, licenses, and commercial needs.

- Provide leadership visibility across key operational initiatives, including progress, priorities, risks, dependencies, and budget utilization.

- Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, HR, Travel, IT, Workplace, and other internal stakeholders.

- Own additional department-wide operational needs, such as senior leadership visits, employee travel, office seating changes, and other organizational initiatives.

- Provide administrative and operational support to the department Chief, including calendar management, travel arrangements, invoice and expense approvals, meetings, and follow-ups.

Requirements

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and drive tasks through completion.

- Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership.

- Experience working with budgets, vendors, events, or operational processes.

- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Ability to work effectively with senior leadership and global teams.

- Ability to understand operational context, translate needs into clear actions, and proactively manage risks, blockers, and dependencies.

- Excellent English and Hebrew.
